opening.argument: The presentation frames Forsage as a successful business and a route to improved quality of life, while prescribing a recruitment structure: “Building a team,” “Inviting new people,” and “Training partners to invite new people.” Its lifestyle appeal says, “you can change the quality of your life,” linking participation to personal improvement. This is an active solicitation, not commentary or education: the speaker says “Join us!” and the description directs viewers to the Forsage website. Together, the recruitment pathway, aspirational benefit, direct invitation, and external destination promote participation in a tiered recruiting opportunity.

citations.quote: 1. Building a team 2. Inviting new people 3. Training partners to invite new people
With Versace, you don't have to change your lifestyle, but you can change the quality of your life.
